descriptions.text: Spellbook of Run, Little Günter, Run. This spellbook is a Special Edition. This means you will learn this spell at level 5, and it will train up faster than usual. Run, Little Günter, Run. Cost: Variable. Minimum 20 mana. Target: This is a summoning spell. It will summon a small, hominid creature named Little Günter. He will appear directly in front of caster. Duration: Once activated, Little Günter will last 20 seconds plus one second per mana point added above the minimum. Higher spell levels decrease mana cost per second. You must activate Little Günter within 30 seconds of summoning him, otherwise he will dissipate. …

beats.headline: The book that cried
beats.text: The spellbook from Carl's 1914 box grew little centipede legs and skittered away the moment it came out. It is bigger than spellbooks usually are, drips a foul-smelling black liquid, whimpers like a dog, and shrieks in a caricatured Austrian accent: stay away, don't touch me, I'll die if you read me. It does not show on the minimap, and Katia cannot examine it. The potion from his Celestial box was like that, Carl says, and so was Donut's War Crime spellbook. The cleaner bot settles it, sucking the book up and dropping it angrily into Carl's arms, and he pulls it into his inventory.

beats.headline: Read anyway
beats.text: The spell is a summoning. Little Günter, a small, fat, child-like creature with a single point of health, appears in front of Carl and waits to be attacked. The attack is stored, Günter runs as fast as he can toward a designated target, or away at random, and the stored attack lands when he gets there or times out. Carl's mind whirls: his Daughter's Kiss, a bomb. Katia asks whether Donut could store a trigger spell on him. There is only one way to find out, Carl says, and applies the book. Warmth spreads over him as he learns the spell.

beats.headline: Get the god
beats.text: In Khepri's temple, with its endless hallway, as Vinata's three guards charge, Carl casts it. A short, fat, pink-skinned kid in lederhosen appears, licking a massive lollipop. Hi, I'm Günter! Get the god, Carl yells, meaning Khepri, and then the very big bomb goes off. Günter, in theory, should be unhurt by the blast and now running down the hallway toward the deity with it stored, effectively doubling the attack. While Carl's body re-forms, a second explosion comes, distant. That, he suspects, is Günter finally catching up to the bug god.

beats.headline: A mallet blow, delivered
beats.text: The kangaroo boss is level 170 and heals himself by eating gremlins. Carl casts the spell, and the chunky, pig-nosed kid in lederhosen appears with a lollipop of a new colour: Hi, I'm Günter! Pontiff, already in his backswing, wallops him with his glowing mallet and bounces back as if he had hit a wall. Nein, nein, Günter shrieks, and runs straight at the kangaroo, who coos at the baby. When Günter reaches him, the delayed mallet strike lands, and the massive kangaroo flips through the air onto his back.
